theorems.name: Submission.dph_lpf_proper_transfer
theorems.statement: (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G g : Eucl m → Eucl m') (F : Set (Eucl m)) (d : ℝ), IsClosed F → Continuous g → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (g x) (G x) ≤ d) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (g ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) ∧ (∀ (m m' : ℕ) (G F₀ F₁ : Eucl m → Eucl m') (F : Set (Eucl m)) (d : ℝ), IsClosed F → Continuous F₀ → Continuous F₁ → (∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact (G ⁻¹' K ∩ F)) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (F₀ x) (G x) ≤ d) → (∀ x ∈ F, dist (F₁ x) (G x) ≤ d) → ∀ K : Set (Eucl m'), IsCompact K → IsCompact ((fun y : Eucl (m + 1) => F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) + (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0) • (F₁ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))) - F₀ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y))))) ⁻¹' K ∩ {y : Eucl (m + 1) | EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ F}))
